gloss: to become blurry; to become vague

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: ぼやけていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to become blurry; to become out of focus
definitions.explanation: For vision, images, or outlines to become unclear or indistinct.

definitions.gloss: to become vague; to become unclear
definitions.explanation: For ideas, memories, distinctions, or boundaries to become unclear or indistinct. Used figuratively.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is physical blurriness — vision, photos, or outlines becoming unclear. Sense 2 is figurative — ideas, arguments, or memories losing clarity. Written in hiragana in most contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぼやける (photo becomes blurry)
- ⟦{視界|しかい}→視界：14137_shikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぼやける (vision becomes blurry)
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぼやける (memory becomes hazy)
- ⟦{論点|ろんてん}→論点：21049_ronten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぼやける (the point becomes unclear)
- ⟦{輪郭|りんかく}→輪郭：14295_rinkaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぼやける (the outline becomes blurred)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぼんやり→ぼんやり：03727_bonyari⟧: vaguely, dimly — adverb describing a hazy state
- かすむ: to become hazy — more literary, used for distant views
